basic_details.scholarship_name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Artificial Intelligence (EMAI)
basic_details.offering_entity: European Education and Culture Executive Agency (EACEA) & EMAI Consortium
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Universitat Pompeu Fabra (UPF - Barcelona, Spain), Sapienza Università di Roma (Rome, Italy), Radboud Universiteit (Nijmegen, Netherlands), Univerza v Ljubljani (Ljubljana, Slovenia)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision, Robotics, Cognitive AI, and Ethical AI Systems.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~20 to 24 prestigious Erasmus Mundus scholarship grants awarded globally per cohort
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open globally under Partner Country quota; typically 2 to 4 Pakistani scholars selected per intake
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 24 months (2 full academic years across multiple European universities)

nationality_requirements: Open to candidates from all countries worldwide, including Pakistan (Partner Country category)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: No age restriction under Erasmus Mundus programme regulations.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Recognized 4-year Bachelor of Science (BS / BSc 16-year) in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Mathematics, Data Science, Software Engineering, or Physics with minimum CGPA 3.50 / 4.00 (78%+).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum CGPA 3.50 / 4.00; competitive candidates typically hold CGPA >= 3.75 / 4.00 with high grades in math and AI courses.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Substantial university coursework in linear algebra, calculus, probability & statistics, algorithms, data structures, and Python programming.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or enrolled in final undergraduate year graduating prior to July 31 preceding September intake.
eligibility_requirements.graduation_year_restrictions: No restriction on year of graduation.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Practical machine learning projects, Kaggle competitions, open-source code repositories, or AI research publications strongly enhance ranking.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic minimum 6.5 (no band below 6.0) or TOEFL iBT minimum 92 (no section below 22). MOI certificates are not accepted by EMAI consortium.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: Consortium languages (Spanish, Italian, Dutch, Slovenian) are not required; coursework is 100% in English.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Erasmus Mundus NDICI / IPA III Partner Country scholarship quota applies to Pakistani nationals.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Candidates who have previously benefited from an Erasmus Mundus Master or Doctoral scholarship are ineligible.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition fee waiver across all partner universities (worth EUR 18,000 for non-EU students).

admission_application_fee.details: Direct application via EMAI consortium portal is completely free.

accommodation.details: Covered directly from the EUR 1,400 / month living allowance; partner universities assist with student residence reservations.

monthly_stipend.details: EUR 1,400 / month tax-free living allowance for up to 24 months (total EUR 33,600 | ~PKR 425,000 / month).

airfare.details: EUR 3,000 per year travel and mobility contribution for Partner Country students living >4,000 km away.

visa_fee.details: EUR 1,000 installation grant covers visa processing, medical attestations, and initial arrival logistics.

health_insurance.details: Full worldwide comprehensive health, emergency, and travel insurance meeting Erasmus+ requirements.

food_allowance.details: Covered via monthly EUR 1,400 living stipend plus access to subsidized university dining halls across Spain, Italy, Netherlands, and Slovenia.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Full digital access to AI research libraries, IEEE, ACM, and high-performance GPU compute clusters.
books_and_materials_allowance.amount: Full university library and GPU cluster access

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Master thesis internship placements in partner industrial AI labs and European research centers.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Mobility travel grant between consortium host nations (Barcelona, Rome, Nijmegen, Ljubljana).
travel_transit_allowance.amount: Covered via Erasmus mobility travel budget

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Multiple host institutions (UPF Barcelona, Sapienza Rome, Radboud University Nijmegen, University of Ljubljana).
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Premier European institutions in artificial intelligence, cognitive computing, and natural language processing.
available_majors: Year 1 (UPF Barcelona): Fundamental AI, Machine Learning, Logic, and Ethics
Year 2 Track A (Sapienza Rome): Intelligent Systems & Computer Vision
Year 2 Track B (Radboud Nijmegen): Cognitive Computing & Human-Centered AI
Year 2 Track C (Univ of Ljubljana): Data Science, Robotics & Bio-inspired AI
Semester 4: Master Thesis with Industrial or Academic Partner
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor degree in Computing, Math, or Engineering (CGPA >= 3.50/4.00), official IELTS (min 6.5) or TOEFL (min 92), CV, statement of purpose, two academic references via online portal.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Single consolidated application for the entire consortium; strong competition focusing on mathematical foundations and ML portfolio.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Demonstrate strong mathematical grounding in linear algebra and multivariable calculus alongside practical PyTorch or TensorFlow projects.

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the EMAI portal, select Year 2 specialization track preferences, upload transcripts, CV, statement of purpose, English test score, and register two referees before January 31.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Review EMAI mobility tracks, curriculum modules, and admission criteria on upf.edu/web/emai.
Step 2: Prepare attested academic transcripts, degree certificate, Europass CV, statement of purpose, and IELTS/TOEFL scorecard.
Step 3: Register on the EMAI online application portal.
Step 4: Fill application details and submit all required documents before January 31.
Step 5: Consortium Selection Committee reviews applications and scores candidates based on academic and mathematical profiles.
Step 6: Shortlisted candidates attend an online technical interview in February.
Step 7: Consortium publishes initial ranking and sends scholarship nominations to EACEA in March.
Step 8: Final scholarship award notification delivered in April; visa documentation and acceptance letters dispatched.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated Routing: Single consolidated application for both degree admission and Erasmus Mundus scholarship funding.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted online by two university academic professors directly via referee invitation link.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Max 2-page statement explaining passion for artificial intelligence, chosen Year 2 track, relevant machine learning projects, and ethical AI vision.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Brief outline of desired thesis area within machine learning, computer vision, NLP, or cognitive AI.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Europass format CV highlighting programming languages, machine learning frameworks, GitHub repositories, and academic honors.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Online technical interview with consortium professors testing mathematical foundations and machine learning principles.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic 6.5+ (min 6.0 each) or TOEFL iBT 92+ (min 22 each).
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: HEC degree attestation required for Pakistani applicants.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Official English translation for all academic records.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Online submission via EMAI consortium portal.

required_documents_checklist.specification: HEC-attested undergraduate degree in Computer Science, AI, Mathematics, or Software Engineering.
Complete transcripts showing all subjects, grades, and CGPA (min 3.50 / 4.00).
Europass format CV highlighting AI/ML projects, mathematical background, and code repositories.
Structured statement of purpose detailing interest in AI, track preferences, and future vision.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Highlight mathematical rigor and ML project experience.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Confidential evaluation letters from university professors submitted directly via portal.
Official IELTS (min 6.5) or TOEFL iBT (min 92) certificate.
Clear color copy of valid Pakistani passport.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Scholarship applications close January 31; self-funded applications accepted until May.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 45% (Academic performance, mathematical rigor, and computing foundation)
selection_process_and_weights.extracurricular_and_leadership_weight: 5% (Participation in Kaggle, AI hackathons, community coding initiatives)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 25% (Quality of statement of purpose, ML project portfolio, and research orientation)
selection_process_and_weights.work_experience_weight: 5% (Machine learning internships or software development experience)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (Clarity of vision and alignment with consortium tracks)
selection_process_and_weights.interview_weight: 5% (Online technical interview probing mathematical logic and ML concepts)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Joint Academic Selection Committee comprising professors from UPF, Sapienza, Radboud, and Univ of Ljubljana.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Consortium scoring grid evaluating previous curriculum match, GPA, SOP, references, and interview performance.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~2,000 to 2,800 worldwide applications (among highest in Erasmus Mundus catalog)
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~4% to 6% among top computing and math graduates
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: 3.80 / 4.00 with strong mathematical coursework and published code
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates in computer science, software engineering, or mathematics with hands-on deep learning experience and solid algorithmic intuition.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates from NUST, FAST-NUCES, LUMS, GIKI, and ITU Lahore.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, India, Nigeria, Brazil, Turkey, Colombia, Vietnam, Indonesia.

fake_websites_and_scams: Only apply via the official EMAI portal https://www.upf.edu/web/emai.
Beware of fraudulent consultants claiming backdoor entry into Erasmus Mundus programs.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Applying for the EMAI Erasmus Mundus scholarship is completely free.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: No recruitment agencies or educational consultants are affiliated with the EMAI consortium.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Apostille and HEC degree attestation charges in Pakistan: ~PKR 15,000 - 25,000.
Initial visa application fee in Islamabad prior to arrival (reimbursed via €1,000 installation grant).
Transit travel between consortium partner countries (subsidized by €3,000/year travel grant).
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: You must already know Spanish or Italian to apply. Reality: All coursework across UPF, Sapienza, Radboud, and Ljubljana is taught 100% in English.
Myth: Only CS majors can apply. Reality: Strong math and physics majors with proven Python and data structure skills are highly competitive.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial sources claim MOI is acceptable; the EMAI consortium strictly enforces official IELTS or TOEFL score reports.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must successfully earn 60 ECTS credits each academic year to progress between mobility tracks.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Mandatory full-time attendance across all consortium university modules and partner AI workshops.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Joint Consortium Academic Board monitoring at the end of each semester.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Scholars may not engage in full-time outside employment that compromises academic participation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; zero service bond or return obligation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Revocation of scholarship and recovery of unspent funds in case of withdrawal or academic misconduct.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Mobility tracks are determined upon admission; changes permitted only under exceptional academic circumstances with board approval.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Not applicable to joint master's programme.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Funding is strictly capped at 24 months.
